title: Philipp Payments
evidence_cutoff: Records reviewed through 18 October 2026; individual datasets have earlier cutoffs. Proposal 4813 receipt verified from its 7 June 2024 block.
scope: Philipp is the single display heading for his identified accounts, Eris and the project funding and fee streams below. Product and account names identify the route and purpose. The total combines gross funding, work pay, revenue, expenses and locked capital; it is not personal net profit or a claim of sole legal ownership of every recipient. It is not a damages calculation.
price_basis: USD figures for recorded receipts use the preserved historical market references, generally the preceding completed hour, not today’s token price or realized sale proceeds. Unpriced means no defensible receipt-time USD value has been joined.

received.meaning: 23 recorded work-pay receipts, including 8,640 USDC claimed on 17 October 2026. Project grants and expenses are separate.

received.title: Neutron project grants
received.meaning: Two 50,000-USDC awards. Subsequent transfers of 90,000 to Superbolt and 10,000 to another professional account are later uses of this funding.

additional.meaning: Includes ROAR-hub and other fee tokens. Quantities exist in the source ledgers; missing historical prices contribute no dollars to the main total. These are not zero-value receipts.
